faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PAU Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the offline application for the PAU Research Fellow position is 21 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The educational qualification includes B.Sc/B.Sc. Agri/B.Sc Forestry with a minimum OCPA of 6.0/10.0 or 60% marks. Alternatively, M.Sc. Soil Science with a minimum OCPA of 6.5/10.0 or 65% marks and CSIR-UGC/ICAR NET qualified, or M.Sc. Soil Science with a minimum OCPA of 6.5/10.0 or 65% marks without NET is also accepted. A Ph.D. in the relevant discipline is also eligible.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 31,000/- p.m. (fixed) plus 16% HRA for candidates with NET qualification. For candidates without NET, the salary is Rs. 25,000/- plus 16% HRA.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Research Fellow position at PAU?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out carefully, attach the required documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the PAU Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for all categories is Rs. 200/-. This fee should be paid in the form of a bank draft in favour of the Comptroller, PAU, Ludhiana.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any age limit for the Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Please refer to the official notification for specific age limit details. The notification will contain information regarding the minimum and maximum age requirements for the Research Fellow position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Fellow position at PAU primarily involves an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience, and then called for an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the duration of the contract for the Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The contract is for a period of six months or till the termination of the scheme, whichever is earlier. This is a contract-based position.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Punjab Agricultural University (PAU), which is https://pau.edu/. The direct link is also provided in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What documents do I need to submit with the application form?
faq.answer: You need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational certificates. Please refer to the official notification for a complete list of required documents.
